verdict.rationale: Unstructured documents dedicated-instance/VPC deployment options (full data isolation, tailored pricing) and GDPR compliance, which implies some customer control over where data resides, but there is no explicit region-selection feature, multi-region hosting options, or documentation describing how a customer chooses a specific data residency zone. Missing for 10: explicit region/residency selection UI or config, list of supported hosting regions, and independent confirmation that VPC deployment lets customers pick geographic location.
